name: a week of calendar cards fans out
looks: Under a claim about weekly timing, five date cards fan out left to right from a narrower starting cluster, each showing a date, an earnings count and small pre/post-market company chips, settling into an even row.
build: variant-stack-reveal: five DOM cards ease from a tighter overlapping cluster to an even spaced row on staggered springs (10-20% stagger), each card's chip icons fading in right after it lands.
sound: A soft cluster of card-settle ticks, one per card.
prompt: Under a claim about a week's schedule, fan a row of date cards out from a tighter starting cluster into an even spread, each one revealing a few small detail chips the moment it settles. Let the fan-out read as a calendar unfolding, not a static grid appearing.
